narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>There are only two right angles, because two creases give two angles.
<bookmark mark='four'/>Open the paper and look at the creases. They cross, so angles form on every side of the meeting dot.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Count them one by one around the dot, and you will find more than two.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says only two right angles; the 2 creases are drawn crossing at O, and the 4 angles around O are marked one by one with small squares; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, open the paper and fit the corner of another sheet into each of the four angles.
<bookmark mark='own'/>Then write your own folding steps for a friend, and see if they get the same four angles.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the steps: fold a crease onto itself, press, open, count 4; the words write your own steps for a friend appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says there are only two right angles, because two creases give two angles. The creases cross, so four angles form around the meeting point, and the bubble is struck.
